name: Produce Flame
description: Conjuration cantrip, Druid access only. Bonus Action, Self, V/S, ten minutes, no Concentration. A harmless flame in your hand sheds Bright Light 20 feet and Dim Light another 20. Ends if cast again. While active, a Magic action makes a ranged spell attack against one creature or object within 60 feet, hit 1d8 Fire; 2d8/3d8/4d8 at levels 5/11/17. The flame does not ignite objects just by being held. No slot or counter; normal hand/component requirements.
